| Volume | Liters | Gallons (US) |
|--------|--------|--------------|
| 38 L   | –      | **≈ 10.04 gal** |

\( \text{Gallons} = \frac{\text{Litres}}{3.785411784}\approx\frac{38}{3.785411784}=10.0407…\)

Rounded to two decimal places, that’s **10.04 gal**.

So when you head to the gas pump, just tell the attendant you’ll take *exactly 10.04 gallons*. If you’re working with UK gallons (where 1 UK gal ≈ 4.54609 L), it would be roughly 8.36 gal instead.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can assist you with!
